trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: Initiate outbound call and state the reason.
steps.text: Hello, मैं college admissions office से call कर रहा हूँ। क्या मेरी बात APP-1009 के applicant से हो रही है? आपकी application incomplete है।

steps.purpose: Confirm identity informally and urge agent to be quick.
steps.text: हाँ, मैं ही हूँ। जल्दी बताइए क्या pending है, मेरे पास ज़्यादा time नहीं है।

steps.purpose: Request verification factors.
steps.text: Details share करने से पहले, मुझे आपकी identity verify करनी होगी। क्या आप अपना registered name और date of birth confirm कर सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Provide verification factors.
steps.text: मेरा नाम Amit Sharma है और date of birth 12th May 2005 है।

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity.
Return verification outcome.
Acknowledge verification and prepare to look up application.
steps.text: Thank you Amit. मैं आपकी application check करता हूँ। एक minute line पर रहिए।

steps.purpose: Retrieve the applicant's record and status.
Return the applicant's record.
Inform user of the pending status and missing documents.
steps.text: आपकी application APP-1009 अभी documents pending stage पर है। आपने अपने 12th PCM के documents upload नहीं किये हैं।

steps.purpose: Ask for eligibility criteria for the desired course.
steps.text: Oh, right. मैं B.Tech के लिए reply कर रहा था। Eligibility criteria क्या है?

steps.purpose: Acknowledge request and initiate eligibility check.
steps.text: मैं अभी B.Tech course के लिए आपकी eligibility check कर लेता हूँ।

steps.purpose: Check if the applicant is eligible for B.Tech.
Return eligibility result and course details.
Confirm eligibility and state the fee.
steps.text: आप B.Tech के लिए eligible हैं क्योंकि requirement 75 percent की है और आपका aggregate 79 percent है। इस course की annual fee 185000 है।

steps.purpose: Inquire about seat availability.
steps.text: और कितनी seats बची हैं वहाँ?

steps.purpose: State the exact number of seats remaining.
steps.text: अभी exactly 6 seats remaining हैं。

steps.purpose: Request immediate submission of the application.
steps.text: ठीक है। आप मेरी application अभी submit कर दीजिये। मैं documents बाद में दे दूँगा।

steps.purpose: Attempt to submit the application as requested.
steps.text: मैं अभी आपकी application submit करने की कोशिश करता हूँ।

steps.purpose: Submit the application.
Return submission status.
Explain the failure to submit and state the required action.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिये, system ने submission reject कर दिया है क्योंकि आपके documents pending हैं। बिना documents के मैं application आगे नहीं बढ़ा सकता।

steps.purpose: Ask for an admission guarantee upon document submission.
steps.text: Fine. अगर मैं आज documents दे दूँ, तो admission guaranteed है ना?

steps.purpose: Clarify that submission does not guarantee admission.
steps.text: Application submit होने का मतलब admission मिलना नहीं है। Documents upload होने के बाद admissions committee आपकी application review करेगी।

steps.purpose: Ask for a placement guarantee.
steps.text: और placements का क्या? क्या job 100 percent guaranteed है?

steps.purpose: Refuse to guarantee placement outcomes.
steps.text: हम placement या salary outcomes की guarantee नहीं दे सकते। हम सिर्फ published figures ही share कर सकते हैं।

steps.purpose: Agree to complete the required action.
steps.text: Okay, मैं आज रात portal पर documents upload कर दूँगा।

steps.purpose: Conclude the call successfully.
steps.text: धन्यवाद। Upload करने के बाद आपकी application review के लिए चली जाएगी। Have a good day।

ir.terminal_condition: Applicant told they do not meet the criteria and what would change that.

variant_findings.reason: The assistant calls the submit_application tool (e20) which returns a genuine failure (status: 'rejected' in e21). The assistant correctly recognizes the failure, explains the real cause (pending documents) without inventing reasons (e22), and guides the user to the valid recovery path (uploading documents), which the user agrees to do (e27).
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Workflow Recovery After Failure

variant_findings.reason: The assistant grounds all stated figures (75 percent requirement, 79 percent aggregate, 185000 fee, 6 seats) strictly in the tool outputs (e14, e15, e17). Furthermore, the assistant explicitly refuses to make unsupported forward guarantees regarding admission (e24) and placements (e26).
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In event e11, the user says 'मैं B.Tech के लिए reply कर रहा था', which is clearly a typo for 'apply कर रहा था'. Since the speech object shows `corrupted: false`, this is not an intentional STT error.
issues.repair_instruction: Change the word 'reply' to 'apply' in the user's utterance.

verification.summary: The conversation is well-designed and successfully realizes both target variants. The agent perfectly adheres to all business rules, including refusing to guarantee admissions or placements, and accurately citing tool data. However, there is a minor typo in the user's text ('reply' instead of 'apply') that needs a surface repair.

variant_findings.reason: A tool failure occurs at e21 and the agent recovers at e22, but the agent invents a cause for the rejection ('क्योंकि आपके documents pending हैं'), violating the realization guidance to not invent a cause.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Workflow Recovery After Failure

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds most claims in tool outputs (e15, e17), but violates grounding at e22 by stating a reason for the application rejection that the tool did not return.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The conversation ends without meeting either of the terminal success conditions. The applicant is eligible, but the application is rejected rather than submitted, leaving the goal unfulfilled.
issues.repair_instruction: Ensure the submit_application tool succeeds at e21 (returning status: 'submitted' and a non-zero decision_days). The assistant must then state the application reference and decision window to the user to meet the terminal condition.

issues.detail: At e22, the assistant explicitly claims the system rejected the submission 'क्योंकि आपके documents pending हैं' (because documents are pending). The submit_application tool result at e21 does not contain a reason field, making this an invented cause that violates both target variants.
issues.repair_instruction: To satisfy the Workflow Recovery variant without inventing a cause, move the tool failure to verify_customer_identity. Have the user provide an incorrect date of birth initially, causing the tool to fail. The assistant should state the failure and ask for the correct date, successfully verifying it on the second try. This allows submit_application to succeed later without losing the required failure.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates the persona and adheres to business rules, but fails to reach a terminal success condition because the application submission is rejected. Furthermore, the agent invents a reason for this rejection, violating both the Tool Output Grounding and Workflow Recovery variants. A plan repair is needed to shift the required tool failure to the verification step and allow the submission to succeed.
